description: Derived lookup index for government-job records. This file contains stable references and normalized lookup attributes rather than full job records.

rules.stableId: The job ID must remain stable across content updates unless the underlying post identity changes.

eligibilityIndexing.direct: Jobs where B.A. English Honours satisfies the documented academic requirement and no known mandatory condition remains unsatisfied.
eligibilityIndexing.conditional: Jobs where B.A. English Honours is academically relevant but one or more additional conditions must be satisfied.
eligibilityIndexing.notEligible: Jobs that require a qualification or mandatory condition not available to the baseline candidate.
eligibilityIndexing.manualVerification: Jobs for which the available evidence does not justify a definitive eligibility result.

negativeMetricHandling.stress: Higher value means more stress, not better suitability.
negativeMetricHandling.physicalRisk: Higher value means greater physical risk, not better suitability.
negativeMetricHandling.transferBurden: Higher value means greater transfer burden, not better suitability.
negativeMetricHandling.nightDutyBurden: Higher value means greater night-duty burden, not better suitability.
